scope: 45 supplied English cards for existing notes; resolved through the approved path map. Existing detailed text and PNG pixels are preserved.
review_method: Opened every supplied image at full resolution in a two-card inspection sheet. Read original-paper method, result-table attribution and limitations; cross-checked numeric tokens against the same-revision PDF. Token presence supplements manual dataset/protocol attribution rather than verifying it automatically.

papers.method_review: Coordinate-conditioned Pi3X-derived model fuses RGB with georeferenced translation anchors and optional ray/depth/rotation priors. Footprint-based overlapping chunks pass shared-view depth priors and merge hierarchically with gravity-preserving transforms.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4: best average aerial-block and UAVScenes reconstruction among compared systems; per-scene rankings vary. PDF-only source v2 was read directly.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs georeferencing; evaluation uses perturbed ground-truth pose priors and aligned geometry. Removing rotation priors hurts performance; results do not establish absolute geolocation guarantees.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Train the VGGT aggregator; unified hand/camera token queries cross-attend to multi-view features, then MANO and camera heads decode geometry. Mixed real single-view, real multi-view and synthetic data use available hand/camera labels plus reprojection consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4 and Table 1: improves against VGGT-camera plus POEM baselines on hand datasets; calibrated GT-camera methods remain stronger in several settings.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires hand localization/cropping; absolute wrist depth remains ambiguous. Metrics use root-relative or Procrustes alignment.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Training-free StreamVGGT cache management preserves first-frame keys/values, ranks candidate keys by dissimilarity to their mean direction, and keeps diverse tokens under adaptive per-layer budgets, independently per head. Does not need attention matrices and supports FlashAttention.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Long3D has five real indoor/outdoor continuous sequences of about 2,000-10,000 frames. Reconstruction uses ICP alignment; finite long-stream experiments show favorable accuracy/depth with some completeness trade-offs.
papers.qualifications_review: Fixed cache does not eliminate accumulated drift. Small budgets can hurt quality; finite benchmarks do not prove error-free endless operation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DUSt3R backbone gains noisy-target pointmap embeddings, timestep conditioning and adaLN modulation. Context can be encoded once; one shared clean-target predictor serves direct one-step prediction and repeated decoder evaluations along a flow.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 3.3, Table 3 and Appendix E: ten versus one step lowers flying-pixel rates across five zero-shot depth datasets and veil rates on four dense-GT datasets, while pointwise depth error slightly worsens.
papers.qualifications_review: Cleaner separated surfaces need not be geometrically truer; weak context permits plausible wrong completion. More steps add computation and no new observations.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Use Sobel edges and local token variance to preserve geometry-important tokens; merge sources into destination anchors, cache merge indices across neighboring layers and unmerge for dense output. Full configuration also includes fine-tuning and FP8.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 ScanNet-50 with 1,000 images on NVIDIA H20: 127.2 s versus 1275.1 s memory-optimized VGGT-star. DTU/CO3D metrics still trail vanilla VGGT in several settings.
papers.qualifications_review: The speedup is configuration-specific, not token merging alone. Fine details can be lost and FP8 requires compatible hardware.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Posed masked object views feed dense coarse volume reconstruction; foreground patches and near-surface voxels drive high-resolution sparse residual prediction. Native sparse attention uses explicit 3D routing and block-aware sequence-parallel GPU balancing.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-5: improved GSO novel-view fidelity, and inverse-rendering experiments on StanfordORB, DTC and OWL use distinct variants/protocols.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires camera poses and foreground masks. Roughness/metal ambiguity and tiny-text errors remain; object-scale validation does not establish large-scene results.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Jointly trained CUT3R-derived model decouples tracking and mapping: an online-updated MLP fast-weight memory supplies a pose-token prior; decoder posterior updates the MLP, while a channel-wise gate updates fixed-size explicit geometry tokens.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Evaluated on pose, depth and reconstruction; pose tests span 50-1,000 frames with Sim3 alignment. TTT3R/TTSA3R combinations are extra variants rather than the base memory alone.
papers.qualifications_review: Finite-sequence aligned results do not establish drift-free tracking. Additional test-time update strategies must be distinguished from base-model gains.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A single-image ViT/convolutional decoder predicts affine-invariant pointmaps and a valid-region mask. Fit focal length and depth-axis shift by reprojection to obtain camera-space geometry up to scale. Training uses robust optimal global alignment, multiscale local geometry and normal supervision.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4 and Appendix D: strong average pointmap/depth performance on eight unseen benchmarks, with improved local geometry. No quantitative result is invented on the card.
papers.qualifications_review: No absolute metric scale; thin structures can flatten or disappear and independent single-image predictions do not enforce temporal consistency.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Shared ViT encodes all views. Multiple reference-conditioned decoder paths see all views; cross-reference blocks exchange the same input view's tokens across paths. Use the first path's heads for aligned pointmaps/confidence. Optional jointly trained Gaussian heads enable novel-view rendering.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4: tested with 4-24 views on HM3D, ScanNet and zero-shot MP3D; improves over DUSt3R in the reported settings without subsequent global alignment.
papers.qualifications_review: MP3D zero-shot cases remain difficult; reference choice still matters and larger-view generalization depends on the training recipe.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: MASt3R-SLAM pairs current RGB with latest keyframe. Freeze MASt3R and update lightweight visual prompts on selected keyframes using confidence-weighted local fused geometry and two historical global references as self-supervision.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-5: lower average TUM RGB-D and NRGBD trajectory error in reported calibrated/uncalibrated configurations, with competitive 7-Scenes/NRGBD dense reconstruction.
papers.qualifications_review: Static scenes assumed; prompt optimization adds cost and accuracy improvements do not imply better scene coverage on every metric. No test-time depth input.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Shared DINOv2 image encoder and symmetric cross-view attention use no reference-view or order embedding. Heads predict local point maps, confidence and cameras; one shared fitted scale supervises geometry and pairwise relative poses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.2: permutation equivariance and competitive multi-dataset geometry, with gains varying by metric. Point-map evaluation uses coarse Sim(3) followed by ICP.
papers.qualifications_review: Monocular global scale is unknown. Alignment-based reconstruction results do not establish absolute metric or drift-free mapping.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Post-training W4A4 quantization combines pre-global Hadamard rotation, post-local channel smoothing, per-output-channel weights and per-token activations. Calibration filters activation outliers and clusters frame-to-first-frame similarity for diverse samples.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1, CO3Dv2 camera pose with 20 frames: W4A4 AUC@30 is 88.2 versus 90.0 for full-precision 16/16. DTU and scene reconstruction are separate evaluations.
papers.qualifications_review: Small CO3D calibration set may not cover deployment domains. Quantization still loses accuracy and measured speed depends on implementation and hardware.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Train a Pi3-derived model from scratch using RGB and known intrinsics, without multi-view 3D or pose labels. DepthPro relative-depth pseudo-labels regularize shape with ambiguity-weighted normalization; CoTracker correspondences and angular reprojection train registration.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3.2-3.3 and Tables 1-2: DL3DV training and zero-shot ScanNet++ evaluation improve on early feed-forward models, while stronger fully supervised systems retain a gap.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs intrinsics and inherits pseudo-label errors. No large-scale data scaling study; dynamics are not explicitly handled.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT patch-mean features define a cosine graph. Inference-time soft grouping balances coherent subscenes; the same first-frame anchor is prepended to every parallel attention group to retain a common output frame.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I: Neural RGB-D, 500 frames, one A100, bfloat16: 9.934 FPS versus 2.732 for the VRAM-efficient VGGT-star baseline. Can combine with FastVGGT token merging.
papers.qualifications_review: Grouping has overhead and changes quality: accuracy and normal consistency can worsen despite better completeness. Long indoor tests do not establish arbitrary-scene scalability.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Freeze CUT3R or STream3R. Archived camera tokens plus a learned base query produce relative-pose queries; asymmetric attention lets queries read image tokens without modifying image features. Multi-reference edges and loop closure drive online pose-graph optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 3.3-3.4 and Table 1: long KITTI trajectory gains over online baselines; additional indoor and synthetic driving tests use their stated scale-handling protocol.
papers.qualifications_review: Bounded by frozen backbone failures. Appearance-based loop detection can miss revisits; hand-set thresholds and accumulated drift remain.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: One transformer supports causal frontend tracking and full-attention backend map refinement. Backend-updated map tokens refresh the shared KV cache for later frames. KV pruning retains queries while reducing stored keys/values.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 6 TUM RGB-D frontend/backend ablation: average ATE RMSE falls from 0.134 m to 0.039 m. This is an ablation result, not a universal external-baseline comparison.
papers.qualifications_review: Accumulating global map tokens increases memory and backend work. Aggressive KV pruning hurts accuracy; evidence is mainly indoor.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Align MASt3R dense geometry to sparse SfM anchors using global RANSAC similarity alignment. SAM groups semantic outlier regions for local similarity corrections; corrected dense plus sparse points initialize per-scene Gaussian optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3.2 and 4: sparse-view NVS on Mip-NeRF360, Tanks and Temples and MVImgNet. Fair-comparison implementation uses 500-step test-pose optimization for all baselines and SPARS3R.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires successful SfM and adequate local correspondences. Segmentation errors break regional alignment; the full system includes per-scene optimization.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Data-free entropy minimization selects layer-wise weight-mixing coefficients for frozen VGGT and MoGe-2 DINO weights. A dual neck subtracts scaled VGGT frame-attention features from MDE features; downstream stereo decoder or conversion inpainting is then trained.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 2.5 and 4.2-4.5 distinguish training-free backbone construction from trained downstream tasks. KITTI/Scene Flow stereo matching and Mono2Stereo/Inria 3D Movie conversion are separate benchmarks.
papers.qualifications_review: Weight-entropy is a proxy rather than a task-optimality guarantee. The combined neck costs memory; training-free does not describe the entire pipeline.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Calibrated surgical stereo produces FoundationStereo pseudo-depth; CUT3R fine-tuning combines depth/pose supervision and consistency. Sparse global and dense local models align segment starts, distribute endpoint drift and stitch trajectories.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I, SCARED, RTX 4090: 19.7 FPS versus MegaSaM 0.7; ATE is 5.514 versus 2.002 mm, so higher speed does not mean lower pose error.
papers.qualifications_review: StereoMIS evaluation uses self-generated pseudo ground truth. Authentic dynamic surgical ground truth is still needed; results do not establish clinical safety.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Keep pretrained CUT3R frozen. A closed-form state update uses a per-token gate given by sigmoid of mean state-query/observation-key alignment, retaining old memory when confidence is low.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Appendix Table 1: KITTI video depth with 500 frames has Abs Rel 0.131 versus CUT3R 0.152. Appendix C.4 separates per-sequence scale-aligned from metric evaluation.
papers.qualifications_review: Reduces forgetting without eliminating drift. Offline full-attention methods can be stronger; state-reset and fine-tuned variants are separate configurations.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Post-trained VGGT replaces each global-attention KV representation with a fixed-size MLP. L2-normalized keys fit ShortConv2D-mixed values; queries read the fast weights, typically after two test-time updates. Minibatch gradient accumulation supports host offload and multiple GPUs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 4.2: 7Scenes with 1000 images takes 58 seconds, 11.6 times faster than VGGT in the reported setup. The card follows the section result, not the abstract’s 54-second wording. HTML labels this plot Figure 3; the same-revision PDF labels it Figure 4.
papers.qualifications_review: Offline collection processing and test-time optimization remain. Softmax attention retains a reconstruction-quality advantage, especially for wide baselines.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.
papers.source_locator_note: Source locator: the runtime plot is Figure 3 in the arXiv HTML and Figure 4 in the same-revision PDF; Section 4.2 reports 58 seconds for 1,000 images.

papers.method_review: Satellite RGB and native RPC cameras feed a frozen VGGT with trainable ray-consistent low-rank adapters. A Ray Transformer scores height hypotheses. Frozen MoGe-2 supplies relief; an analytic height-origin anchor plus invariant residual places the datum, and calibrated inverse-variance fusion combines relief.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table IV, 26 held-out US3D tiles, zero ground control and no reference alignment: absolute MAE 2.99 m at 91.9% coverage.
papers.qualifications_review: Zero-control height inherits the delivered RPC frame; unobservable bias requires external control. Low-order gauge and relief-only uncertainty do not cover per-tile datum error.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Local attention with time/height/width RoPE and reliability gates supplies correspondences. A fixed recurrent geometric state uses learned channel-wise retention; metric readout and pose-token fusion decode depth scale and relative camera poses.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 full KITTI sequences: mean ATE 19.75 m without loop closure and 16.44 m with optional loop closure. Trained on 48-frame clips; finite long-sequence tests support the claim.
papers.qualifications_review: Fixed memory can lose revisit details; dynamics can corrupt matching. Optional loop retrieval and pose-graph optimization add storage and computation beyond recurrent state.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen CUT3R state updates use consecutive-token cosine novelty and SVD effective rank at 95% energy. A capped product scales the update; accumulated update/confidence triggers resets, chaining estimated anchor-to-world transforms.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I KITTI Odometry: Sim(3)-aligned average ATE 30.48 m versus LongStream 51.24 m. The network weights remain frozen; only online state changes.
papers.qualifications_review: Base rate and reset threshold are dataset-specific. Estimated reset alignment can accumulate drift; aligned trajectories do not prove metric absolute accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Pool per-image global tokens and exchange cross-view context before returning it to patches. A retrieval-guided shortest-path tree retains N-1 stereo edges; breadth-first confidence-weighted closed-form Procrustes merges local point maps without iterative global optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 Tanks and Temples, 200-view setting, NVIDIA V100 32 GB: 33.4 s versus MASt3R-SfM 1609.0 s.
papers.qualifications_review: Speed trades against strict pose accuracy. Closed-form per-edge alignment still occurs; not demonstrated at tens of thousands of images and latent context retains a quadratic image-count term.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Chunk-wise bidirectional geometry reasoning combines sparse sliding-window attention over adjacent chunks with TTT fast-weight memory for long-range context. Apply the prior memory to a chunk, then update for the next; slow network weights are frozen at inference.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 in source v2: KITTI average ATE 25.44 m for LoGeR and 18.65 m for LoGeR-star. The star variant uses feed-forward overlap pose alignment in training and inference, not the older optimization variant.
papers.qualifications_review: Chunk-causal rather than strictly frame-causal. Fast-weight compression is lossy; very long streams drift and optional resets sacrifice history.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: VGGT builds per-agent local RGB submaps. MAGMA retrieves reference views, encodes point geometry plus appearance/spatial/camera tokens, registers the new map and refines reference maps. Cross-agent overlap detection connects maps; backend pose-graph optimization reduces drift.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 8 reports 9 FPS on synthetic ReplicaMultiagent in a two-agent setup. Real-world AriaMultiagent tracking is a separate three-agent evaluation.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs overlapping places to connect agents. Strong illumination/weather shifts and more than three agents remain insufficiently evaluated; the full system includes optimization.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Lenscope renders synthetic indoor scenes across camera models with exact rays/depth/poses and connected covisibility. Full-FOV resize, native-aspect embedding and pixel-inferred panorama wrap adapt MapAnything to mixed-camera tuples; heads predict rays, depth, poses and scale.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 heterogeneous 2D3DS: 88 tuples of 3-24 views; tuple-averaged pose mAA@30 is 80.4 versus Wid3R 54.3 with supplied camera classes.
papers.qualifications_review: Indoor synthetic adaptation uses up to eight views. Trails Wid3R for 15-24-view tuples; pose scoring is scale-invariant and predicted metric scale is 12-25% too small. Real mixed views are resampled from panoramas.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A DINOv2 convolutional branch predicts affine-invariant geometry; a separate CLS-conditioned MLP predicts scene scale. During training-data refinement only, locally aligned synthetic-teacher geometry filters real labels and log-space Poisson completion fills missing depth.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 metric geometry averaged across seven datasets: depth relative error 15.7% versus UniDepth V2 21.3%. This differs from relative-geometry and GT-camera columns.
papers.qualifications_review: Thin lines and hair remain difficult; large foreground/background scale gaps bend structures. Out-of-distribution metric scale can deviate.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A shared multi-view transformer predicts ray origins/directions and depth; ray-derived points anchor Gaussian centers while shared features predict appearance. Rendering, camera and raymap supervision couple geometry and appearance during training; increasing viewpoint gaps mix with close-pair replay.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 DL3DV with 24 input views: novel-view PSNR 24.242 dB versus YonoSplat 22.174 dB. This is NVS quality under the stated view setting.
papers.qualifications_review: Pose-free inference still uses pose and raymap supervision in training. Sampling is hand-designed; drift robustness is not a drift-free guarantee.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Training-free StreamVGGT cache management scores current tokens by Gaussian-smoothed FFN residual magnitude and historical tokens by key diversity. Fixed per-layer budgets evict unprotected tokens; first-frame and capped high-confidence historical anchors preserve coordinates.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 KITTI depth with 500 frames: Abs Rel 0.135 versus InfiniteVGGT 0.257. Appendix E explicitly documents accumulated drift.
papers.qualifications_review: Past predictions are never globally corrected. Constant per-frame resources do not imply drift-free geometry or constant total output storage.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Spatial pointers store global 3D positions plus appearance/geometry features. Intertwined image-memory decoders with hierarchical 3D positional encoding predict local/global point maps and pose; patch-average global points locate new pointers, fused or inserted by nearest-neighbor threshold.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 KITTI video depth: Abs Rel 0.093 after per-sequence scale alignment, versus 0.169 with no metric alignment.
papers.qualifications_review: Memory grows with explored area; extra spatial entries can interfere with pose. Strong relative geometry does not ensure accurate absolute scale.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen CUT3R retains the TTT-style update direction. Alignment, state reconstruction residual and recent update pressure propose a rate; state deviation and attention entropy estimate reliability, blending the candidate with a conservative baseline rate.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 state-update ablation, 1000-frame ScanNet: Sim(3)-aligned ATE 0.2106 versus TTT3R 0.4230.
papers.qualifications_review: Conservative writes can lose detail and short-stream gains vary. Tested on compact recurrent states; alignment is not proof of absolute metric accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Run a frozen geometry model under small photometric jitter and reordered views. Robust trimmed Sim(3) registration aligns predicted point maps to a reference before covariance-trace uncertainty; default is per-view stabilization, with scene-level alignment evaluated separately.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 6.3: three backbones and six datasets. Label-free core beats built-in confidence in 11 of 18 conditions; full held-out calibration/fusion reaches 15 of 18 and uses labels.
papers.qualifications_review: Stable systematic errors can have low variance. Cross-domain calibration transfers poorly, repeated passes cost time, and no novel-view-synthesis benefit was observed.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Jointly encode a uniform anchor subset; subsample intermediate tokens from every layer into compact scene memory. Each query attends to its own tokens and scene memory, never other queries. Direct pose and dense heads localize all images, including anchors.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 base feed-forward SAIL-Recon, Tanks and Temples averaging over 300 images per scene: RRA@5 70.4%, RTA@5 74.7%, registration 100%. OPT is separate optional rendering-based pose refinement.
papers.qualifications_review: Uniform anchors can miss scene regions and a fixed reference can hurt some sequences. Memory/detail trade-offs remain; the base result is not the OPT variant.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: LightGlue correspondences are computed once and filtered during test-scene adaptation. Pose-only epipolar and pose-plus-depth multiview losses are combined after projecting the latter gradient orthogonal to the former. SO(3) bins sample views; only attention-QKV LoRA is updated.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table II selected pose results: Pi3 ETH3D AUC@3 rises 0.33 to 0.41, while VGGT ScanNet++ falls 0.56 to 0.54. Six variants on four datasets do not improve every entry.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs reliable external matches; repetitive/textureless scenes and limited overlap weaken supervision. Per-scene optimization is not real time; GT-free refers to adaptation, not pretraining or evaluation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: I2P predicts window-local point maps using keyframe queries and pooled supporting views. A bounded reservoir retrieves scene references; L2W fuses image and encoded 3D tokens to register keyframes directly in scene coordinates without explicitly solving cameras.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 7Scenes: mean accuracy 2.13 cm and completeness 2.34 cm across test sequences. Evaluation uses Umeyama plus ICP; runtime is about 25 FPS on one NVIDIA 4090D.
papers.qualifications_review: Designed for static scenes. No explicit camera head prevents global bundle adjustment; poses recovered from clouds lag dedicated camera-localization systems.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Pool query/key blocks to estimate a coarse attention distribution. Combined CDF threshold and minimum top-k select patch-to-patch blocks; camera/register tokens and their cross-interactions stay dense. Original pretrained encoders and heads remain.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Section 5.2, Tanks and Temples: sparse Pi3 on 200 frames runs about twice as fast on H100 at 75% effective sparsity, with comparable evaluated pose quality.
papers.qualifications_review: Sparsity can reduce pose accuracy. End-to-end speedup is smaller than attention-only speedup; the sparse model is not expected to outperform its dense baseline.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Shared ViT plus frame self-attention and causal cross-attention read cached earlier-view features. First two views initialize context; a first-frame register anchors coordinates. Two DPT heads and a pose head decode local/world geometry and cameras.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 KITTI, per-sequence scale alignment, A100, 512 by 144: beta Abs Rel 0.080 at 12.95 FPS; beta-W[5] 0.083 at 32.93 FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Full-history cache grows with length; windows lose old observations. Causal errors accumulate, outputs are deterministic, and aligned depth does not establish metric-scale accuracy.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Average relative transforms of shared cameras to align submaps without noisy point fitting. Voxel-sampled control points propagate through shared-pixel projection/unprojection until invalid. Robust repeated observations and smoothed displacement targets fit regularized 3D thin-plate spline deformations.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 Waymo with VGGT backbone: mean trajectory ATE RMSE 1.09 m versus VGGT-Long 1.42 m. Umeyama alignment is applied; multi-camera baselines are reproduced within a unified framework.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs overlap and usable predicted cameras. Control propagation can terminate; tested primarily on multi-camera driving scenes, not every scene class.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Train per-frame, per-layer MLP routing to sparsity branches. Input-conditioned weighted aggregation creates representative tokens for global keys/values while queries stay dense; dense frame attention preserves local detail. Geometry losses and sparsity regularization train the model.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 ScanNet, 500 frames: end-to-end VGGT 90.1 s versus TurboVGGT 20.3 s on the same single data-center GPU. Source specifies approximately 140 GB HBM but no exact GPU model.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires training. Variable token counts complicate batching; lower training memory comes with more training compute. Temporal dynamics are not explicitly modeled.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT coarse-stride chunks connect the farthest nonadjacent fine chunks through reliable shared-frame Sim(3) fits. Reverse selected coarse chunks in loop-sparse regions to oppose anchor scale bias; robust joint pose-graph optimization combines sequential, loop and skip edges.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 KITTI Odometry: mean translation ATE RMSE 22.61 m versus reproduced VGGT-Long 24.85 m, with Sim(3) Umeyama alignment.
